北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京霾天，气温 6℃，注意防护，出门戴好口罩哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing has haze and 6℃. Protect yourself and wear a mask when going out!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪雾气浓，路滑湿冷，出行请注意安全，放慢脚步。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is foggy, roads are slippery and it's humid. Please drive safely and take your time.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天 12℃，体感微凉，记得添衣保暖，保持好心情！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is overcast at 12℃, feeling a bit cool. Remember to add layers and keep a good mood!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州雾重 20℃，湿度大。注意交通安全，保持清爽。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is foggy and humid at 20℃. Be careful on the roads and stay refreshed.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云 20℃，体感舒适。湿度不低，也别忘了防潮。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is partly cloudy and comfortable at 20℃. Enjoy the weather, but mind the humidity.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州雾气浓 12℃，体感略凉，出行注意安全，记得防潮。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is foggy and 12℃, feeling cool. Travel safely and watch out for dampness.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京有雾，气温 11℃ 体感 8℃，出门多穿点，注意慢行。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is foggy, 11℃ feels like 8℃. Dress warmly, and take it slow on the roads.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，湿度 100%，记得除湿防潮，保持衣物干爽。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast with 100% humidity. Remember to dehumidify and keep your clothes dry.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有雾，湿度 94%，能见度低。驾车出行请减速慢行。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy with 94% humidity, low visibility. Drive slowly and carefully.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，湿度 100%，感觉湿冷。多穿点衣服，小心着凉。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast with 100% humidity, feeling damp and cold. Dress warmly to avoid catching a cold.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，微风习习，体感 12℃。注意添衣，保持舒适。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast with a light breeze, feeling like 12℃. Remember to layer up and stay comfortable.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨有霾，体感 -1℃。天寒地冻，请您务必注意保暖。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin has haze, feeling like -1℃. It's freezing, please make sure to stay warm.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴天 3℃，体感 0℃。天气寒冷，记得多穿衣服哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is overcast at 3℃, feeling like 0℃. It's cold, remember to dress warmly.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗 9℃，体感舒适。昼夜温差大，早晚注意添衣。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is clear and 9℃, feeling comfortable. Mind the temperature difference between day and night.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门有雾 17℃，湿度高。出行注意安全，小心湿滑。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is foggy at 17℃ with high humidity. Be safe on the roads, watch out for slipperiness.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有雾，气温 8℃。能见度不高，出行多注意安全。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is foggy at 8℃. Visibility is low, please be extra careful when traveling.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连有霾，气温 8℃ 体感 5℃。出门记得戴口罩防霾。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian has haze, 8℃ feels like 5℃. Remember to wear a mask when you go out.
